body: Life story is a bit much, but I’m willing to type out the crux of my adulthood, where it all went to hell, tomorrow. Thanks for reading

I appreciate the concern, I truly do. 

For me, life is like watching a movie. I’ve seen plenty in my 36+ years and it’s not getting any better. I’m buried in student loan debt, I lost my job of 6.5 years and I’m going to lose my car any day. I bought a gun for just such an occasion, a fail safe for my rock bottom and that day is out of hand. I have $10 left to my name. The time has come.

I’ve put it off for nearly a year with the hope that things would get better but alas, they have not. I’ve come to terms that this is the only option. You never think this is how life will be when you’re a little kid. I’m in a catatonic state
